transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I... I'm just here because of work. Dispatch and compliance, they've been... tracking my route changes. Through the computer system, mostly. And the radio. People say it's just normal oversight, but... I know certain drivers are reporting on me.
How certain are you that your coworkers are deliberately reporting on you?

I... I just know. You can tell. The way they look at me when I pull into the yard, the... the little comments they make on the radio. It's not just regular oversight. They're watching my route changes on the computer and... and telling dispatch. I just know they are.
Do you think it’s possible you might be mistaken about your coworkers reporting on you?

No. I... I'm not mistaken. 

People keep telling me that. They say it's just normal oversight. But... I'm not wrong. The computer system, the comments on the radio... I know what I'm seeing. I know they're reporting me.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No. I... I don't hear things like that. Just what comes through the radio.
Do you believe your coworkers are using any special technology or other unusual means to monitor or influence you beyond the normal computer system and radio?
No. Just... just the computers and the radio. I haven't seen anything else. They don't really need anything else to do it.
How long have you believed that your coworkers are reporting on you?
Um... about two months, I guess. That's when it became clear to me. The tracking... with the computer system, and the comments on the radio. Just for about the past two months.
Have other people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No... I don't think so. Nobody has said anything like that to me.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness?
No. Um... no, I haven't. Nothing like that.
Have you found yourself losing motivation to do everyday things?

I guess... a little. I just don't really feel like singing with the choir lately. Or having the softball team over. Most days after my shift, I just... I sit at the kitchen table. I'll have my planner open, but I just can't make myself start dinner, or make calls, or... anything really.
Before these past two months, have you generally tended to distrust other people?
No... not really. I don't think so.
Have you been feeling unusually depressed lately?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really... sad, if that's what you mean. Just what I said before.
Since this started, has your belief that your coworkers are reporting on you continued without going away?

Yeah... it hasn't stopped. Even when people try to tell me it's just normal oversight, I know what's happening. Dispatch and compliance keep tracking my route changes in the computer system. And... I hear the little comments on the radio. I can just tell certain drivers are reporting on me. So, yeah. It hasn't gone away.
Did anything particularly stressful happen in your life shortly before this started?
I don't know if I'd call it stressful, really. But... I guess it's been building for about eight months now. That's... when they put me in the temporary dispatch lead role.
Did this start soon after any physical illness or head injury?
No... I haven't been sick. And I didn't hit my head or anything. So... no. Nothing like that.
Have you had the feeling that outside forces are putting thoughts into your mind?
No... I don't think so. I just... think my own thoughts.
Have other people said that your face seems less expressive than usual?

I don't know about my face. People haven't really said that. But... I haven't been around them much lately to hear it. I just don't feel like singing with the choir anymore, or... having the softball team over. 

Most days after my shift, I just go home and sit at the kitchen table. I have my planner open, but... I can't make myself start dinner. Or make calls, or... anything else, really. I just sit there.
Do you feel unable to get yourself to start ordinary tasks, even when you want to do them?
Yeah... like I was just saying. I look at my planner and I just... can't do any of it. Even if I know I need to make dinner, or do normal things... I just sit there.
Since this started, have you felt emotionally flat or less able to show your feelings?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't noticed feeling flat. I just feel how I usually feel, I guess.
Did this change come on suddenly?
No... not suddenly. It's been building up for... about eight months, I guess. Right around when I was put in the temporary dispatch lead role.
When you hear those comments on the radio, do they ever seem clearly meant just for you, even when they sound like ordinary transmissions to everyone else?

Yeah... I guess. People keep saying it's just normal oversight, but... I know what I hear. Dispatch and compliance, they've been tracking my route changes through the computer system. And then... they make those little comments on the radio. I can just tell certain drivers are reporting on me. That's kind of why I'm here.
